description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 9 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 9.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.
Thanks for your interest for our models.
Best Regards.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 60 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 60.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.
Thanks for your interest for our models.
Best Regards.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 52 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 52.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 44 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 44.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.
Thanks for your interest for our models.
Best Regards.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 65 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 65.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.
Thanks for your interest for our models.

  - Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR WHEEL RIM 79 GAME READY WHEEL RIM TIRE
Ortas presents you Wheel Rim no 79.

  - Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.

  - Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game. To make the modification easier for you, we are giving you the Blend file.

  - Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.

  - Using this rim is very easy in your games, the tire, wheel and rim is tested in game engines and the directions are settled. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file; plug it into your car and it is done!

  - In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left side wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.

  - In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 

  - All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.

  - We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see, investigate and purchase many other types of tires.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR WHEEL RIM 120 GAME READY WHEEL RIM TIRE
Ortas presents you Wheel Rim no 120.

  - Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.

  - Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game. To make the modification easier for you, we are giving you the Blend file.

  - Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.

  - Using this rim is very easy in your games, the tire, wheel and rim is tested in game engines and the directions are settled. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file; plug it into your car and it is done!

  - In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left side wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.

  - In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 

  - All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.

  - We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see, investigate and purchase many other types of tires.

description_text:
The Polish G-Class Main Road Modular Building Kit is a high-quality, highly customizable 3D asset pack designed to create realistic Polish-inspired road networks for your projects. With modular pieces that include roads, intersections, sidewalks, and roadside elements, this kit is perfect for urban planning visualizations, simulation games, city-building games, and architectural renderings.
This pack is modeled to real-world dimensions, ensuring accuracy for both game development and professional presentations. The design is inspired by the distinct layout and structure of Polish G-class (main) roads, making it an excellent choice for recreating authentic environments.
Key FeaturesModular Road System
Straight road segments, curves, T-junctions, 4-way intersections, and roundabouts.Seamlessly connectable pieces for flexibility in design.Realistic Design Elements
Accurate markings for Polish G-class roads, including lanes, crosswalks, and arrows.Sidewalks, curbs, and pedestrian paths with realistic dimensions.Roadside Accessories
Streetlights, signboards, traffic lights, and roadside barriers.Polish-style road signs, parking spaces, and bus stops for added realism.PBR Texturing
High-resolution (4K) textures for asphalt, concrete, and road markings.Includes normal, roughness, metallic, and albedo maps for photorealistic rendering.Performance-Optimized Models
Low-poly versions for real-time applications such as games and VR.High-poly versions available for cinematic renders.Customizable Components
Modular pieces can be combined to create various road layouts.Easily replace textures or edit UVs for unique customization.ApplicationsSimulation Games: Ideal for driving, city-building, and urban management simulators.VR/AR Experiences: Perfect for immersive environments requiring authentic road layouts.Architectural Visualizations: Create Polish-inspired urban scenes for presentations.City Planning Tools: Build road layouts for urban development projects.Technical SpecificationsFile Formats: FBX, OBJ, BLEND, UnityPackage (for Unity users).Textures:4K PBR textures for asphalt, road markings, and accessories.Separate materials for sidewalks, roads, and signage.Polycount:Low Poly: Optimized for real-time applications (~500 to 2,000 polys per piece).High Poly: For detailed renders (~5,000 to 10,000 polys per piece).UV Mapping: Clean and non-overlapping UVs.Scale: Modeled to real-world dimensions, accurate to Polish G-class road standards.Included AssetsRoad Segments:
Straight segments (5m, 10m, and 20m lengths).Curves (15°, 30°, and 90°).Intersections and Connectors:
T-junctions, 4-way intersections, and roundabouts.Merge lanes and lane dividers.Roadside Elements:
Sidewalks, curbs, and bike lanes.Polish-style traffic signs and poles.Decorative Accessories:
Streetlights, traffic lights, benches, and trash bins.Bus stops and parking meters.Special Pieces:
Crosswalks, pedestrian islands, and speed bumps.Highway entry/exit ramps for advanced layouts.Why Choose This Kit?The Polish G-Class Main Road Modular Building Kit is specifically tailored for developers and designers looking to create realistic Polish-inspired environments. Its modular system ensures endless customization possibilities, while its optimized performance and high-quality textures make it suitable for both games and cinematic projects.
License and SupportFully licensed for personal and commercial use.Includes dedicated support for any questions, customization requests, or format conversions.

description_text:
This low-poly box truck model is a highly optimized and versatile asset, perfect for real-time applications such as mobile games, architectural visualizations, or background elements in larger scenes. It strikes an excellent balance between performance and visual fidelity.
Technical SpecificationsThe model is built with efficiency in mind, ensuring it can be rendered in dense scenes without a significant performance hit.
Polygons: 4,860
Vertices: 5,366
Topology: Features clean, professional topology consisting primarily of quads. The mesh flow is optimized for clear silhouettes while maintaining a low resource footprint.
UV Mapping: The model is fully UV unwrapped with a non-overlapping layout, making it easy to apply custom decals, logos, or weathered textures.
Design and AestheticsThe truck features a cab-over design, providing a modern yet utilitarian look that fits into various urban or industrial environments.
Materials: It utilizes realistic PBR-ready materials. The cab features a brushed metallic finish, while the windows and light covers utilize appropriate transparency and reflective properties.
Lighting Elements: The model includes modeled headlight and taillight housings. The taillights are textured with a vibrant red emissive quality, while the front signals feature a warm amber glow, as seen in the renders.
Cargo Area: The large, white rear box provides ample space for custom branding or advertisements, functioning as a blank canvas for level designers.
Key FeaturesOptimized for Performance: High visual impact with a very low poly count.
Ready for Integration: The clean mesh and standard material setup allow for easy importing into engines like Unity, Unreal, or Godot.
Versatile Design: Suitable for city traffic simulations, logistics-themed games, or as a static prop in stylized environments.
Note: The lighting and dark studio environment in the provided renders highlight the model's clean edges and the way the materials react to directional light sources.

description_text:
Low poly, scale to your liking
Anti-aircraft (AA) guns, also known as anti-aircraft artillery, are weapons designed to engage and destroy hostile aircraft. These guns come in various sizes, types, and configurations depending on the intended use, the threat they are designed to counter, and the era in which they were developed. Here's a general description of AA guns:
Purpose: AA guns are primarily used for defense against aerial threats, including enemy aircraft, helicopters, drones, and sometimes even missiles. They are typically deployed to protect military installations, ships, convoys, and other high-value assets from airborne attacks.
Types: AA guns can be classified based on various criteria such as caliber, firing mechanism, mobility, and purpose. Some common types include:
Heavy AA guns: These are large-caliber guns mounted on stationary or mobile platforms. They are capable of engaging high-flying or heavily armored targets. Medium AA guns: These guns usually have a smaller caliber than heavy AA guns and are more mobile. They are effective against medium-altitude threats. Light AA guns: Smaller caliber guns, often mounted on vehicles or used as portable infantry weapons. They are employed against low-flying aircraft, helicopters, and ground targets. Automatic AA guns: Rapid-firing guns capable of engaging multiple targets quickly. They are often used for close-range defense against aircraft and drones. Caliber and Ammunition: AA guns can range from small-caliber machine guns to large-caliber cannons. The caliber determines the effectiveness against different types of aircraft and the range at which they can engage targets. Ammunition for AA guns can include explosive shells, tracer rounds, and armor-piercing projectiles.
Fire Control Systems: Modern AA guns are often equipped with sophisticated fire control systems, including radar, tracking systems, and computerized aiming mechanisms. These systems enhance accuracy and allow for effective engagement of fast-moving aerial targets.
Mobility: Depending on the intended use, AA guns can be mounted on various platforms such as stationary emplacements, towed trailers, trucks, armored vehicles, ships, and aircraft. Mobile AA guns provide flexibility and can be rapidly deployed to areas under threat.
Countermeasures: AA guns may be equipped with countermeasures such as flak bursts, smoke screens, and decoy systems to confuse or deter enemy aircraft and missiles.
Overall, AA guns play a crucial role in air defense strategies, providing a last line of defense against aerial threats and contributing to the protection of military forces and critical infrastructure.

Automatic AA guns: Rapid-firing guns capable of engaging multiple targets quickly. They are often used for close-range defense against aircraft and drones. Caliber and Ammunition: AA guns can range from small-caliber machine guns to large-caliber cannons. The caliber determines the effectiveness against different types of aircraft and the range at which they can engage targets. Ammunition for AA guns can include explosive shells, tracer rounds, and armor-piercing projectiles.
Fire Control Systems: Modern AA guns are often equipped with sophisticated fire control systems, including radar, tracking systems, and computerized aiming mechanisms. These systems enhance accuracy and allow for effective engagement of fast-moving aerial targets.
Mobility: Depending on the intended use, AA guns can be mounted on various platforms such as stationary emplacements, towed trailers, trucks, armored vehicles, ships, and aircraft. Mobile AA guns provide flexibility and can be rapidly deployed to areas under threat.
Countermeasures: AA guns may be equipped with countermeasures such as flak bursts, smoke screens, and decoy systems to confuse or deter enemy aircraft and missiles.
Overall, AA guns play a crucial role in air defense strategies, providing a last line of defense against aerial threats and contributing to the protection of military forces and critical infrastructure.

A MUFFLER (NORTH AMERICAN ENGLISH) OR SILENCER (BRITISH ENGLISH) IS A DEVICE FOR REDUCING THE NOISE EMITTED BY THE EXHAUST OF AN INTERNAL COMBUSTION ENGINE—ESPECIALLY A NOISE-DEADENING DEVICE FORMING PART OF THE EXHAUST SYSTEM OF AN AUTOMOBILE.
MUFFLERS ARE INSTALLED WITHIN THE EXHAUST SYSTEM OF MOST INTERNAL COMBUSTION ENGINES. THE MUFFLER IS ENGINEERED AS AN ACOUSTIC DEVICE TO REDUCE THE LOUDNESS OF THE SOUND PRESSURE CREATED BY THE ENGINE BY ACOUSTIC QUIETING. THE NOISE OF THE BURNING-HOT EXHAUST GAS EXITING THE ENGINE AT HIGH SPEED IS ABATED BY A SERIES OF PASSAGES AND CHAMBERS LINED WITH ROVING FIBERGLASS INSULATION AND/OR RESONATING CHAMBERS HARMONICALLY TUNED TO CAUSE DESTRUCTIVE INTERFERENCE, WHEREIN OPPOSITE SOUND WAVES CANCEL EACH OTHER OUT.

description_text: In this design, an attempt has been made to use the perspective of the existing contradiction to design the elements of urban furniture. The stillness and suspension of the two paradoxes form a concept that can attract the audience's senses and change the urban mood because what is less felt in our urban spaces today is the same kind of variety and charm that Fermi has. It can create curiosity and mental vitality for the citizens in a constructive and positive direction. The present design's elements are arranged to contrast with our ordinary ideas. Bases that do not seem to be connected and evoke a sense of suspense, chains that, despite the tensile role in the distribution of forces, seemingly play the role of compressive forces, creating a degree of continuity while separating the elements and in a nutshell Creating a new concept of stasis that in its expression reveals a manifestation of geometric instability. It is essential to create a different definition of urban furniture elements in terms of structural expression while maintaining regular use. Creating another presentation from the static one, which at first glance reveals a kind of suspension in space, creates a pleasant mental effect on the citizens. It is worth mentioning that the strength and efficiency of this design have been thoroughly evaluated and do not include any problems due to the lack of a functional purpose in urban furniture as well as damage from the perspective of the impact of vandalism.

description_text:
Rogal Door Battle Tank for Battlemace 40 million  Astral Guard army. The tank was inspired by a Rogal Dorn battle tank, that has not been released as of writing this - therefore the exact measurments might be off by a couple of milimeters - i will most likely update it to fit the exact dimensions later on and simply add/modify the files. Each part has a redundant geometry feature(s) located in normally non-visible areas that allow for painless assembly, if printed right. The sponson weapon slots and sponson weapons were made to be compatible with parts made by other modelers/companies.
DISCLAIMER - Tank on the photos is without tracks not because they are not included, but because putting them on in a simulation proved to be nigh impossible. I will submit photos of the assembled model once it's ready.
As of now, the files contain:
Tank parts:

  - Hull

  - 1 Side with a sponson slot (mirror it in slicer to get a second part)

  - 2 Sponsons

  - Tracks of various lengths (1-6 link long) (mirror them in slicer to get tracks for the second side)

  - Turret (hatches closed)

Weapons:

  - Oppressive cannon

  - Twin combat cannons

  - Pintle stubgun

  - Hull gatling gun

  - Hull powderiser cannon

  - Front stubgun

  - Front melter gun

  - Sponson Heavy nailer

  - Sponson Multi melter

  - Side panels

  - Sponsonless sides

  - Frontal caps (no front weapons version)

Coming soon:
  - Track guards
Edit: It took me a while, but here is the update. It contains Sponsonless Sides, Wheel guards, Frontal caps and Twin combat cannon. Enjoy!Edit 2: I just realized how badly designed for printing was the pillar in the turret that connected it with the main hull. I replaced it with a better solution - a Turret an a Turret pillar.
Model parts are not presupported.
These models were inspired by models made by Games Workshop. I am the author of these 3d models and I own them. You are not allowed to spread them without my permission, nor profit from them.

This model is perfectly suited for children's media, educational games, animated series, mobile applications, or any project that benefits from a friendly and engaging vehicle. Crafted with clean topology, it's optimized for easy rigging and animation, ready to transport your audience on imaginative journeys.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 10 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 10.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.
Thanks for your interest for our models.
Best Regards.

description_text:
The Urban Collection was built from the ground up with a modular approach to give artists and layout staff the most flexible and versatile options possible, while maintaining low resource consumption. With customizable material options and to-scale proportions, your games and VR-applications will feel fuller and more immersive with the addition of these real world elements. Featuring UVW unwrapped signage, the pack compliments a wide variety of image-based and procedural shading workflows.
All ground-based assets have their origin points on the floor for easy alignment and placement.
37 unique meshes included:*Windows (2x2', 2x3', 4x2', 6x4', 4x6' with variant)*Doors (Residential with variant, Commercial with variant)*Commercial signage (Facade with variant, Mall Sign with variant)*Traffic signage (Stop, Yield, Avenue markers with four larger variants)*Traffic stands (Streetlights, Traffic standards, Traffic lights, Pedestrian crossing light)*People-related (Bus shelter, benches, garbage can)

description_text:
This is a simple model of a car/bus steering wheel.
The model is fully unwrapped and textured so you may use it directly in any of your scene/game or simulation. This part is perfect for scenarios when you require a cheap steering wheel for an already made car model to wrap things up and save time. 
In the preview you will find

  - Keyshot Rendered Images

  - Images from Maya Viewport (Shaded, Shaded Wireframe, Textured and UV)

  - Images from UV after plugging in all the maps and with very minute adjustment to the albedo slider. 

Two types of textures are provided. The first one contains most of the details fused into a single diffuse map. Using this texture might lose some of the details, but will make your scene lightweigth and convenient. On the other hand, if you want all the details, the Unity Texture files are included as well (Albedo, Normal and Metallic Smoothness). If you want to enjoy all of the details as shown in the Unity preview images, simply load up the file in your desired software and plug in the texture files in their proper slots.  (The Keyshot and Maya Images were produced by using just the single texture diffuse map just to give you an idea)
All of the textures are provided in each of  individual format zip files for your convenience. 
Feel free to give me a message if you have any further queries (: 
*Note: Materials are not provided and textures are not embedded. The model only has a default material from Maya, it would be best if you could attach your own material and apply the provided texture image for best results. *

This model contanis 4 different car wheels modeled in Autodesk Maya 2018 based on a real car, specially an Audi RS5.
The model is composed in 4 different models:-Front High Poly model composed on 71268 Tris and 36939 Verts-Front Low Poly model composed on 53476 Tris and 27987 Verts-Back High Poly model composed on 64300 Tris and 33215 Verts-Back Low Poly model composed on 46508 Tris and 24263 Verts
High Poly models are based on a high poly Tire which is added as different fbx and objs too, and the rest of the wheel.Low Poly models are based on a low poly Tire and the rest of the whell, all in one.
The pack is separated in unique packs with 4 wheels, 2 wheels and 1 by 1.
Don't doubt on contacting me so we can negociate whatever you want.
If you like the model please give me some feedback, I would appreciate it. If you experience any kind of difficulties, be sure to contact me and i will help you. Sincerely Yours, ViperJr3D

description_text: Hello... This is a model of post appocalyptic sci fi fighter truck....This model is made only using blender and nothing else. IT is completely textured and shaded in blender. It is very detailed Model and this model is very good for post appocalyptic concept art stuff but it can be used in many places more .... The textures used in this models are CC0 so you can use it in any project without worrying about copyright issues.... There are some graffeti textures used which are made in photoshop soo no worries there too... . all the materials are procedurally generated PBR materials.... Thses materials are with some cool features like they will detect edges by themselves no matter what the surface is ...... You can add the materials to anything and they will look like real stuff...you dont have to do any tweaking..... but you can also customise these materials like color and roughness and bump etc But if you want to go a step further..... we have provided some actual PBR textures that can be used in the texture slots .... and they will give even better results. it is medium detailed model and can be used as main focus as well as a background object..... If you want to change the colors of the trcuk parts there are just color slots and texture node you can switch the color the colors to your liking accoording to your need . if you have any problem with the edge mask you can change the radius of the bevel node top in the node editor.

description_text:
Waiting staff (British English),[1] waitstaff (North American English),[2] waiters (male) / waitresses (female), or servers (North American English),[3][4] are those who work at a restaurant, a diner, or a bar and sometimes in private homes, attending to customers by supplying them with food and drink as requested. Waiting staff follow rules and guidelines determined by the manager. Waiting staff carry out many different tasks, such as taking orders, food-running, polishing dishes and silverware, helping bus tables and restocking working stations with needed supplies.
Waiting on tables is part of the service sector and among the most common occupations in the United States. The Bureau of Labor Statistics estimates that, as of May 2008, there were over 2.2 million people employed as servers in the U.S.[5]
Many restaurants choose a specific uniform for their waiting staff to wear. Waiting staff may receive tips as a minor or major part of their earnings, with customs varying widely from country to country.[6]
Contents1   Terminology2   Roles3   Duties4   Requirements5   Job benefits6   Tipping in the United States7   See also8   References9   External linksTerminologyAn individual waiting tables (or waiting on or waiting at tables)[7] or waitering or waitressing[8] is commonly called a waiter, server, front server, waitress, member of the wait staff, waitstaff,[9] serving staff server, waitperson,[10] or waitron.[11][12][13][14] The last two terms are gender neutral but rarely used, and the terms waiter and server are increasingly used for women too.[15] Archaic terms such as serving girl, serving wench, or serving lad are generally used only within their historical context.
RolesIn large luxury establishments, there are often multiple ranks of waiting staff in the dining room:[16]
Maître d'hôtel, responsible for dining room as a whole, greets guestsFloor managerHeadwaiterExpeditor, or Expo, responsible for ensuring accuracy and completeness of orders. The expeditor is also often responsible for preparing the tray for the servers so they can bring all of the plates of that course to all of the table guests at the same timeCaptain, responsible for several tablesWaiterFront waiterBack waiter, who helps waiters refill water, replenish bread, etc.Bar back, who helps a bartender by bussing, and restocking glassware and alcoholRunner, who brings cooked dishes to dinersBusboy, busser, clears tables, sets tablesIn such restaurants, the captain is typically responsible for interacting with the diners and overseeing waiters.[17]
There are also specialists, notably a sommelier for wine service, and occasionally a maître fromager for the cheese service. A host or hostess may be responsible for seating diners if there is not a maître d'hôtel.
DutiesSaganaki, lit on fire, served by waiters in ChicagoThe duties of waiting staff can be tedious and harsh but are vital to the economic success of restaurants. Such duties include the following: preparing a section of tables before guests sit down (e.g., changing the tablecloth, putting out new utensils, cleaning chairs, etc.); offering cocktails, specialty drinks, wine, beer, or other beverages; recommending food options; requesting the chef to make changes in how food is prepared; pre-clearing the tables; and serving food and beverages to customers. In some higher-end restaurants, servers have a good knowledge of the wine list and can recommend food–wine pairings. At more expensive restaurants, servers memorize the ingredients of the dishes and the manner in which the food is prepared; for example, if the menu lists marinated beef, the customer might ask what the beef is marinated in, for how long, and what cut of beef is used in the dish. Silver service staff are specially trained to serve at banquets or high-end restaurants. These servers follow specific rules and service guidelines, which makes this a skilled job. They generally wear black and white with a long, white apron (extending from the waist to the ankles). At expensive restaurants, waiting staff also keep blacklists of rude customers. Some waiting staff, are trained to deal with aggressive customers and how to restrain them, until security or police arrive. Also they are trained at first aid, specifically the Silver service staff.[18]
The head server is in charge of the waiting staff and is also frequently responsible for assigning seating. The head server must insure that all staff do their duties accordingly. The functions of a head server can overlap to some degree with that of the maître d'hôtel. Restaurants in North America employ an additional level of waiting staff, known as busboys or busgirls, increasingly referred to as bussers or server assistants, to clear dirty dishes, set tables, and otherwise assist the waiting staff.[19][20][21]
Emotional labour is often required of waiting staff,[22] particularly at many high-class restaurants.
RequirementsRestaurant serving positions require on-the-job training that would be held by an upper-level server in the restaurant. The server will be trained to provide good customer service, learn food items and drinks, and maintain a neat and tidy appearance. Working in a role such as captain in a top rated restaurant requires disciplined role-playing comparable to a theater performance.[23]
In the United States, some states require individuals employed to handle food and beverages to obtain a food handler's card or permit.[24] In these States, servers that do not have a permit or handler's card can not serve. The server can achieve a permit or handler's card online.
No food certification requirements are needed in Canada. However, to serve alcoholic beverages in Canada, servers must undergo their province's online training course within a month of being hired.[citation needed]
Job benefitsWaiting offers flexible work schedules and the ability to work on a part-time basis. This makes the profession appealing to students, parents with childcare commitments, and people who also work other jobs.[25]
Most restaurants also provide their employees with free or discounted meals. High end restaurants that have only one dinner meal service often provide a shared staff meal prepared by one of the chefs. The chef may also provide samples of special or new menu preparations so the waiting staff can experience the dish and be better able to describe it for the patron. Other restaurants that have multiple shifts will give an employee a meal for free or at a discount.
In the United States, which does not have universal health care, some restaurants offer health insurance to staff who are employed full-time.
Tipping in the United StatesDifferent countries maintain different customs regarding tipping, but, in the United States, a tip paid in addition to the amount presented on the bill for food and drinks is customary. At most sit-down restaurants, servers and bartenders expect a tip after a patron has paid the check.[26] The minimum legally required hourly wage paid to waiters and waitresses in many U.S. states is lower than the minimum wage employers are required to pay for most other forms of labor in order to account for the tips that form a significant portion of the server's income. If wages and tips do not equal the federal minimum wage of $7.25 per hour during any week, the employer is required to increase cash wages to compensate.[27]
Tips average between 15% and 20% of the bill. 20% is expected for good service, more than 20% is expected for great service, and some patrons tip even more for exceptional service.[28] If the server goes above and beyond to ensure the patron enjoys his meal, it is customary to give a higher tip. Some restaurants charge an automatic gratuity for larger parties (usually 6 or more), and the gratuity ranges from 15% to 20% depending on the restaurant. The amount an establishment requires the customer to pay is a service charge. Service charges, also known as automatic gratuities, are automatically included in the check. Common examples of service charges may include: banquet event fees, hotel fees, bottle service fees, and cruise ship fees

description_text:
This model is created for advertise or mockup.Lubricant oil, commonly known as lubricating oil or simply lubricant, plays a crucial role in various mechanical systems by reducing friction and wear between moving parts. Here are some key uses of lubricant oil:
Reducing Friction:
Machinery and Engines: Lubricant oil is extensively used in engines, gearboxes, and various mechanical components to reduce friction between moving parts. This helps improve efficiency and overall performance.Wear Protection:
Automotive Applications: Lubricant oils are essential for the proper functioning of engines in vehicles. They form a protective film over engine components, reducing wear and extending the lifespan of the engine.Heat Dissipation:
Cooling: Lubricants help dissipate heat generated during the operation of machinery or engines. This is particularly important in high-speed applications where friction can generate significant heat.Sealing and Protection:
Sealing: Lubricants can act as a sealant, preventing the entry of contaminants such as dirt and water into the mechanical components. This protection is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the system.Corrosion Prevention:
Metal Surfaces: Lubricant oils can protect metal surfaces from corrosion, ensuring the longevity of components and preventing rust.Noise Reduction:
Gears and Bearings: By reducing friction and ensuring smooth operation, lubricants contribute to noise reduction in machinery, especially in gears and bearings.Transmission of Power:
Hydraulic Systems: In hydraulic systems, lubricants are used to transmit power efficiently. They also help maintain the proper functioning of hydraulic components.Viscosity Control:
Temperature Regulation: Lubricants come in various viscosities, and their properties can be tailored to specific temperature conditions. This ensures optimal performance in both high and low-temperature environments.Dust and Debris Control:
Industrial Machinery: Lubricants help trap and carry away dust and debris that may be present in industrial settings, preventing them from causing damage to machinery.Specialized Applications:
Aerospace Industry: Lubricants are used in the aerospace industry to meet specific performance requirements under extreme conditions, such as high altitudes and temperature variations.

description_text:
The cartoonish school bus 3D model features a bright, cheerful red body with black stripes along the sides. Large windows with a slight tint and realistic reflections line both sides. The front has a rounded hood, detailed headlights, a bold grille, and a clearly marked school bus sign above the windshield. Side mirrors extend for visibility, and a stop sign arm is ready to extend from the driver’s side. The doors have precise grooves and a transparent glass section. The wheels are large and rugged, with detailed rims and tires for various terrains. The rear includes taillights, a bumper, and emergency exit markings. This cartoonish 3D model is perfect for VR and video games.
Created mostly in Maya 2022, this bus 3D model was textured in Substance Painter and rendered using Marmoset Toolbag. It follows a PBR-Metal/Roughness workflow, including Base color/Albedo, Metalness, Roughness, and Normal maps. The model comes with full textures and mapping in various file formats, making it ready for use in digital bus models, animated bus scenes, and interactive 3D environments. The texture format is PNG with dimensions of 2048 x 2048. This VR school bus model is ideal for cartoonish 3D vehicle simulations and school transportation animations.Features:Originally created in mostly Maya 2022, Textured in Substance PainterRendered all preview images using Marmoset Toolbag.PBR-Metal/Roughness workflow (Base color/ Albedo, Metalness, Roughness, and Normal)The model includes full textures and mapping in every available file format.

description_text:
Minivan (sometimes called simply a van) is a car classification for vehicles designed to transport passengers in the rear seating row(s), with reconfigurable seats in two or three rows [citation needed]. The equivalent classification in Europe is MPV (multi-purpose vehicle) or M-segment - and are taller than a sedan car, hatchback, SUV or station wagon.[2][3][4][5]
Compared with a full-size van, most minivans are based on a passenger car platform and have a lower body. Early models such as the Ford Aerostar and Chevrolet Astro utilized a compact pickup truck platform.[6][7] Minivans often have a 'one-box' or 'two-box' body configuration, a higher roof, a flat floor, sliding doors for rear passengers, and high H-point seating. The largest size of minivans is also referred to as 'Large MPV' and became popular following the introduction of the 1984 Dodge Caravan and Renault Espace. Typically, these have platforms derived from D-segment passenger cars or compact pickups. Since the 1990s, the smaller compact MPV and mini MPV sizes of minivans have also become popular.[8]
Though predecessors to the minivan date back to the 1930s, the contemporary minivan body style was developed concurrently by several companies in the early 1980s, most notably by Chrysler (producer of the Chrysler minivans) and Renault (the Renault Espace), both first sold for model year 1984. Minivans cut into and eventually overshadowed the traditional market of the station wagon and grew in global popularity and diversity throughout the 1990s. Since the 2000s, their reception has varied in different parts of the world: in North America, for example, they have been largely eclipsed by crossovers and SUVs, while in Asia they are commonly marketed as luxury vehicles.

description_text:
Intended for 3d print.
Three variants of armored car. Two APC-style vehicles and one more akin to a tank destroyer or self-propelled artillery. Intended primarily for 28mm scale tabletop games, but can be printed at smaller scales. Depending on the quality of your printer, they may or may not work at 6mm scale.
Designer's notes
The following section is information about the design process, what the idea behind the models were and why they turned out the way they did, et cetera. It is not strictly speaking something you as a customer need to know, but you may find it interesting.
This model kit was a quick sideproject I whipped together while working on an Italian WW2 Autoblinda model. The whimsically namedbattle buses are basically an Autoblinda car body, with its turret sunk into the back section of the body, turning the turret into a driver's cabin. The tank destroyer version of the battle bus was made using the same method, but instead of an Autoblinda turret I used the substantially larger turret of a soviet KV2 tank. All in all, designing the battle buses took me about 15 minutes...
While these are borderline joke models, they do still function perfectly fine as generic tabletop personal transports or mechanized artillery. You could use them as the products of some more obscure STC blueprint in the grim darkness of the far future, or maybe as armored cars in some alternate reality-themed WW2 tabletop wargame.
There is plenty of room on the models for further customization. There are spare tires and jerry cans included in the kit you can use as decoration, and the roofs of the models are perfect places to mount turrets. Incidentally, Sharedog Miniatures sells numerous tank turret you can purchase as separate products on this site.
The models prints one-piece and require no assembly. They are currently not pre-supported, but if you need help adding supports to the models I can help you with it free of charge - just send me a request.

description_text:
This low-poly school bus model is a professionally crafted 3D asset designed to balance visual appeal with high-performance efficiency, making it an ideal choice for real-time applications such as mobile games, VR/AR environments, or background fill for architectural visualizations. Architecturally, the model captures the iconic silhouette of a classic American school bus, featuring a bold yellow-gold body contrasted by sleek black trim and structural detailing. Despite its low-end poly count, the model maintains a high level of fidelity through a clean, optimized mesh composed of 5,002 polygons and 5,468 vertices. This geometry ensures smooth performance across various rendering engines while providing enough definition to support close-up views without noticeable jaggedness.
The asset is fully UV unwrapped with a non-overlapping layout, allowing for easy texture modifications or the application of custom liveries and decals. It utilizes realistic materials that react naturally to lighting, showcasing a subtle metallic sheen on the bodywork and matte finishes on the tires and trim. Key features include detailed wheel hubs, emergency roof hatches, and rear safety lights, all of which contribute to its authentic appearance. The topology is meticulously organized to be free of ngons or stray vertices, ensuring a plug-and-play experience for any production pipeline. Whether used in a stylized simulation or as a lightweight prop in a cinematic city street, this school bus delivers a professional-grade aesthetic without the overhead of high-poly geometry.

description_text: HI.....           this is a rusted rollar model .... modelled and shaded completely in blender... no other plug in was usedThis is common machine in south Asian countries that is commonly used in making road and leveling land area for construction.....This is a kind of vehicle you will find abandoned near road .... once they had a purpose but now they are just reminder of an era that is no more we have more advanced technology now.This model can be used in post appocalpse  type environments ....and if you want something like a destroyer road blocker  thing you can add some thorns and wires and you will end up with the post appocaliptic vehicle. All i am saying that this is not a cool model itself but it can serve as a great starting point to make something more epic.And as for as textures are concerned ... all the materials are procedurally generated PBR materials....Thses materials are with some cool features like they will detect edges by themselves no matter what the surface is ......You can add the materials to anything and they will look like real stuff...you dont have to do any tweaking.....but you can also customise these materials like color and roughness and bump etcBut if you want to go a step further.....we have provided some actual PBR textures that can be used in the texture slots .... and they will give even better results.it is medium detailed model and can be used as main focus as well as a background object.....

description_text:
Animation is a method by which still figures are manipulated to appear as moving images. In traditional animation, images are drawn or painted by hand on transparent celluloid sheets to be photographed and exhibited on film. Today, most animations are made with computer-generated imagery (CGI). Computer animation can be very detailed 3D animation, while 2D computer animation (which may have the look of traditional animation) can be used for stylistic reasons, low bandwidth, or faster real-time renderings. Other common animation methods apply a stop motion technique to two- and three-dimensional objects like paper cutouts, puppets, or clay figures.
A cartoon is an animated film, usually a short film, featuring an exaggerated visual style. The style takes inspiration from comic strips, often featuring anthropomorphic animals, superheroes, or the adventures of human protagonists. Especially with animals that form a natural predator/prey relationship (e.g. cats and mice, coyotes and birds), the action often centers on violent pratfalls such as falls, collisions, and explosions that would be lethal in real life.
The illusion of animation—as in motion pictures in general—has traditionally been attributed to persistence of vision and later to the phi phenomenon and/or beta movement, but the exact neurological causes are still uncertain. The illusion of motion caused by a rapid succession of images that minimally differ from each other, with unnoticeable interruptions, is a stroboscopic effect. While animators traditionally used to draw each part of the movements and changes of figures on transparent cels that could be moved over a separate background, computer animation is usually based on programming paths between key frames to maneuver digitally created figures throughout a digitally created environment.
Analog mechanical animation media that rely on the rapid display of sequential images include the phénakisticope, zoetrope, flip book, praxinoscope, and film. Television and video are popular electronic animation media that originally were analog and now operate digitally. For display on computers, technology such as the animated GIF and Flash animation were developed.

You can find it having deep conversations with poets and philosophers, contemplating the human experience, and contemplating the possibility of its own existence.
So, the next time you encounter the Ghost in the Shell Tachikoma Military Spider Tank, be prepared for a unique and unforgettable encounter. Whether it's cracking jokes, busting a move, or contemplating the mysteries of the universe, this tank is the life of the party. Who knew tanks could be so amusing and thought-provoking?

v A wheel disk, often referred to as a wheel rim or wheel, is a crucial component of a vehicle's wheel assembly. It is the outer circular part of the wheel onto which the tire is mounted. Here are some key aspects of a wheel disk:
Material: Wheel disks are commonly made from materials such as steel, aluminum alloy, or a combination of materials. The choice of material can impact the wheel's weight, strength, and appearance.
Design: Wheel disks come in various designs and styles, ranging from simple and functional to elaborate and decorative. The design can affect the overall aesthetics of the vehicle.
Size: Wheels come in different sizes, typically measured in inches. The size includes the diameter of the wheel and the width of the wheel. The size of the wheel can impact the vehicle's handling and ride characteristics.
Mounting: The wheel disk is designed to securely hold the tire in place. It usually has a bead seat where the tire bead sits, and the wheel is mounted onto the vehicle's axle using lug nuts or bolts.
Finish: Wheel disks can have various finishes, such as polished, painted, or coated to protect against corrosion. The finish not only contributes to the overall aesthetics but also helps protect the wheel from environmental elements.
Offset and Backspacing: These are important measurements that determine how the wheel sits in relation to the vehicle's suspension and body. They affect the wheel's position within the wheel well.
Bolt Pattern: The bolt pattern refers to the number and arrangement of bolt holes on the wheel. It must match the bolt pattern of the vehicle's hub for proper fitment.
When choosing or describing a wheel disk, it's important to consider these factors to ensure compatibility with the vehicle and achieve the desired look and performance.
Disc (Rotor): The disc, often called the rotor, is a flat, circular metal component mounted to the vehicle's wheel hub. When the brake pedal is pressed, brake calipers squeeze brake pads against the disc to create friction and slow down or stop the vehicle.
Caliper: Brake calipers are components that house the brake pads. When the brake pedal is activated, the calipers apply pressure to the brake pads, causing them to make contact with the rotating disc.
Brake Pads: Brake pads are friction materials attached to the caliper. They come into contact with the rotating disc when the brakes are applied, creating the necessary friction to slow down or stop the vehicle.
Brake Fluid: Brake fluid is essential for transmitting the force from the brake pedal to the brake calipers. It also plays a role in heat dissipation within the braking system.
Brake Lines: Brake lines carry brake fluid from the master cylinder to the brake calipers. Proper maintenance of brake lines is crucial for the overall effectiveness of the braking system.
Master Cylinder: The master cylinder is a key component that converts the mechanical force from the brake pedal into hydraulic pressure, sending brake fluid to the calipers.
Anti-lock Braking System (ABS): Many modern vehicles are equipped with ABS, which helps prevent wheel lock-up during hard braking, improving overall control and safety.

Anti-aircraft (AA) guns, also known as anti-aircraft artillery, are weapons designed to engage and destroy hostile aircraft. These guns come in various sizes, types, and configurations depending on the intended use, the threat they are designed to counter, and the era in which they were developed. Here's a general description of AA guns:
Purpose: AA guns are primarily used for defense against aerial threats, including enemy aircraft, helicopters, drones, and sometimes even missiles. They are typically deployed to protect military installations, ships, convoys, and other high-value assets from airborne attacks.
Types: AA guns can be classified based on various criteria such as caliber, firing mechanism, mobility, and purpose. Some common types include:
Heavy AA guns: These are large-caliber guns mounted on stationary or mobile platforms. They are capable of engaging high-flying or heavily armored targets. Medium AA guns: These guns usually have a smaller caliber than heavy AA guns and are more mobile. They are effective against medium-altitude threats. Light AA guns: Smaller caliber guns, often mounted on vehicles or used as portable infantry weapons. They are employed against low-flying aircraft, helicopters, and ground targets. Automatic AA guns: Rapid-firing guns capable of engaging multiple targets quickly. They are often used for close-range defense against aircraft and drones. Caliber and Ammunition: AA guns can range from small-caliber machine guns to large-caliber cannons. The caliber determines the effectiveness against different types of aircraft and the range at which they can engage targets. Ammunition for AA guns can include explosive shells, tracer rounds, and armor-piercing projectiles.
Fire Control Systems: Modern AA guns are often equipped with sophisticated fire control systems, including radar, tracking systems, and computerized aiming mechanisms. These systems enhance accuracy and allow for effective engagement of fast-moving aerial targets.
Mobility: Depending on the intended use, AA guns can be mounted on various platforms such as stationary emplacements, towed trailers, trucks, armored vehicles, ships, and aircraft. Mobile AA guns provide flexibility and can be rapidly deployed to areas under threat.
Countermeasures: AA guns may be equipped with countermeasures such as flak bursts, smoke screens, and decoy systems to confuse or deter enemy aircraft and missiles.
Overall, AA guns play a crucial role in air defense strategies, providing a last line of defense against aerial threats and contributing to the protection of military forces and critical infrastructure.

description_text:
Low poly, scale to your liking
Anti-aircraft (AA) guns, also known as anti-aircraft artillery, are weapons designed to engage and destroy hostile aircraft. These guns come in various sizes, types, and configurations depending on the intended use, the threat they are designed to counter, and the era in which they were developed. Here's a general description of AA guns:
Purpose: AA guns are primarily used for defense against aerial threats, including enemy aircraft, helicopters, drones, and sometimes even missiles. They are typically deployed to protect military installations, ships, convoys, and other high-value assets from airborne attacks.
Types: AA guns can be classified based on various criteria such as caliber, firing mechanism, mobility, and purpose. Some common types include:
Heavy AA guns: These are large-caliber guns mounted on stationary or mobile platforms. They are capable of engaging high-flying or heavily armored targets. Medium AA guns: These guns usually have a smaller caliber than heavy AA guns and are more mobile. They are effective against medium-altitude threats. Light AA guns: Smaller caliber guns, often mounted on vehicles or used as portable infantry weapons. They are employed against low-flying aircraft, helicopters, and ground targets. Automatic AA guns: Rapid-firing guns capable of engaging multiple targets quickly. They are often used for close-range defense against aircraft and drones. Caliber and Ammunition: AA guns can range from small-caliber machine guns to large-caliber cannons. The caliber determines the effectiveness against different types of aircraft and the range at which they can engage targets. Ammunition for AA guns can include explosive shells, tracer rounds, and armor-piercing projectiles.
Fire Control Systems: Modern AA guns are often equipped with sophisticated fire control systems, including radar, tracking systems, and computerized aiming mechanisms. These systems enhance accuracy and allow for effective engagement of fast-moving aerial targets.
Mobility: Depending on the intended use, AA guns can be mounted on various platforms such as stationary emplacements, towed trailers, trucks, armored vehicles, ships, and aircraft. Mobile AA guns provide flexibility and can be rapidly deployed to areas under threat.
Countermeasures: AA guns may be equipped with countermeasures such as flak bursts, smoke screens, and decoy systems to confuse or deter enemy aircraft and missiles.
Overall, AA guns play a crucial role in air defense strategies, providing a last line of defense against aerial threats and contributing to the protection of military forces and critical infrastructure.

description_text:
Little Bunnies with Lights make perfect additions to motorcyles, bikes, or even just a tabletop. The Blender file includes unlinked (or joined) pieces for easily changing the light or moving the ears. 
Tested in Second Life, these bunnies with their lights are 1 - 2 land impact each with a quality LOD. Additionally, they are easy to texture with multiple faces. Further, the bulb face is single, which enables easy scripting.
Perfect for numerous applications as they are low poly, with only 24,872 vertices and 24,914 faces (a total that includes all three bunnies). Each bunny, individual, are approximately 8,088 vertices and 8,102 faces.
Applied to an Easter bike in Second Life that turns the light on and off for riding and reversing.
Includes multiple model versions, textures (for different shadows based on ears), normals, specular, UV Maps, and JPG versions of the main textures to be added where TGAs cannot be used.  UV MAPS are PNG and other textures are TGA.

description_text:
Battery Holder for CR2032 with soldering tabs. Including Battery CR2032.
Some early 1900s battery holders were often no more than a cardboard box with copper contacts. By the 1920s, battery holders used twin metal clips (like fuse holders) to hold the battery in place while making electrical contact. Patent no. 1439429 was granted in Dec. 1922 for an assembly with two spring arm clips, a small switch, and a lamp assembly on the end of connected wires.

In the automotive industry, alloy wheels are wheels that are made from an alloy of aluminium or magnesium. Alloys are mixtures of a metal and other elements. They generally provide greater strength over pure metals, which are usually much softer and more ductile. Alloys of aluminium or magnesium are typically lighter for the same strength, provide better heat conduction, and often produce improved cosmetic appearance over steel wheels. Although steel, the most common material used in wheel production, is an alloy of iron and carbon, the term alloy wheel is usually reserved for wheels made from nonferrous alloys.
